kids_evidence: Not a kids/families app: docs/store-policy/EventSpark.json:85 Apple 1.3 'Kids Category' applies=false ('none of [kids] detected in the current source', generated 2026-10-14); store/apps/EventSpark.json:39 primary_category ENTERTAINMENT. No Kids/Families store metadata found (grep of store/ and docs/). Age-rating questionnaire answers for this app were not read (store/apps/EventSpark.json lists it as having no schema field).

interstitial.why: No AglAds.onTransition() in mobile/lib (grep: none); the spec removed the tab-change interstitial (EventSpark.md:229) and forbids ads on the door, ledger, close-out and forms (:231). Keep it absent: hosts use the app in task-focused moments (checking guests in at the door), where a full-screen ad is intrusive.

native.list_builder: mobile/lib/features/home/home_screen.dart:148 (for (final e in shown) - not a builder)
native.why: The only list is the host's own events (upcoming/past segments, home_screen.dart:64-69,148), typically a handful - not a feed of content. A native row between someone's own events would sit next to private guest/money data and would rarely reach 8 items. The spec keeps exactly one inline banner at the end of Home and no ads on event screens (EventSpark.md:228-231).

rewarded.existing_limit_or_quota: none (grep quota/premium/in_app/purchase in mobile/lib: no hits)
rewarded.why: No free quota or premium extra exists; CSV export, door check-in and ledger are core host tools and must not be gated. Nothing honest to reward.

blockers: Spec ad placement is a pending founder decision (EventSpark.md:232, issue #40; approval request reports/approvals/2026-10-14-eventspark-ads-placement.md - not read by me)
